explanation: The theorem is about the library's own notions, `twoRank` and `ElementaryTwoQuotient` (G/G² as a ZMod 2-module). Neither name appears anywhere in Mathlib, so Mathlib has no declaration with the same statement. The proof is the library's own argument. It bounds the kernel dimension by n and then applies rank-nullity (`LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker`) to the induced surjective map. That is more than a one- or two-line instantiation of a Mathlib lemma. I searched Mathlib only for these two names and did not search for related general results.
